# designagent.dev

Front door for the designagent Claude Code plugin marketplace. Next.js 16 (App
Router) + Tailwind v4. The plugin grid is generated from
`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`; long-form docs are MDX in `content/plugins/`.

# Design spec (generated by DesignAgent — source of truth for UI)
@docs/DESIGN.md

Build UI from the spec above: map its tokens onto the Tailwind theme in
`app/globals.css`, reuse the components in `components/`, and honor the Do's and
Don'ts. Light theme, Inter + DM Mono, black as the only brand color, depth via
borders not shadows.
